title: [home-assistant/core] Fix issue #177185: disabled integration sensors still show up in Overview
description:
Fix GitHub issue #177185 in home-assistant/core:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/177185

Repo:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core

Target:
Ship a real upstream code fix so disabled integration sensors do not keep showing up in the Home Assistant Overview as unavailable.

Required deliverables:
- A real upstream code change against home-assistant/core.
- An upstream pull request linked to issue #177185.
- Testing notes describing what you validated.
- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- The PR must clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit the upstream patch plus the PR.
